description: The Vault webhook connects to an address taken from a pod annotation without validating it, and an annotation can also switch TLS verification off.

provenance.construction: reverse of 76db45976f: the new side of the diff is the code before the change; 1 explanatory line(s) deleted from the old side were dropped so the diff does not explain the fix

expected.rationale: Annotations are controlled by whoever can create a workload. The webhook uses the annotated address for an outbound call made with its own credentials (SSRF), and a second annotation turns certificate verification off. The fix added address validation and an operator opt-in for skipping verification; both are deleted here. GitHub rated the advisory critical.

issues.description: The Vault address from the object annotation is used to build the client with no validation of where it points.
An annotation on the object can disable TLS certificate verification for the Vault connection.
